questions.question: What method must a ModelAdapter provide for run_eval to obtain a generation?
questions.explanation: The runner renders a task prompt and calls each adapter's generate method. The returned Generation carries text and optional confidence or token statistics for scoring.

questions.question: What does run_eval do when parallel=False?
options: It silently drops all but the first task
It processes adapter-task work sequentially before sorting results
It starts one process per task regardless of the flag
It refuses to run unless a ThreadPoolExecutor is available
questions.explanation: The sequential branch evaluates the work items in order. The parallel executor is used only when parallel is true and more than one work item exists.

questions.question: Which threshold does _correct_from_score use for exact_match, accuracy, and code_exec?
questions.explanation: The runner treats exact-match-like metrics as correct when score >= 0.999999. Other metrics use the lower 0.5 threshold, so the distinction is intentional.

questions.question: What happens if two supplied adapters have the same model_id?
options: Their results are averaged under that ID
The later adapter silently replaces the earlier one
run_eval raises ValueError before evaluating tasks
questions.explanation: Model IDs identify leaderboard rows and result keys. run_eval validates uniqueness up front and raises ValueError for duplicate IDs.

questions.question: What perplexity report does _perplexity_blocks produce for an adapter with no token statistics?
options: It fabricates token NLL from the task score
It omits the adapter from the report entirely
questions.explanation: The runner preserves the adapter in the report but records unavailable perplexity as NaN and total_tokens as zero when no token statistics were supplied.

questions.question: Which ordering does the final result list use after evaluation completes?
options: The order in which worker threads finish
Task input order without considering model_id
questions.explanation: Regardless of worker completion order, run_eval sorts TaskResult entries by model_id and task_id so reports are deterministic.
